features: Experience authentic cinema surround sound in your living room. Dolby Atmos and DTS:X create an immersive multi-dimensional soundscape that brings movies to life with the creator’s intent.
Catch every word in the scene with a dedicated center channel speaker that ensures voices remain clear across all content
A powerful wireless subwoofer with a large 160mm speaker unit delivers a deeper, richer bass sound
Hear a wide surround field using only front speakers with digital S-Force Pro.
Enjoy wireless music streaming from your smartphone and other devices.
